verdict.rationale: Codegen's documented issue-tracker abilities are updating statuses, adding comments, linking PRs and creating tasks in Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com. Nothing documents automatic triage of incoming issues, severity suggestions, or routing issues to an owner. These are adjacent issue-management actions, not the triage capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have incoming issues automatically triaged with severity suggested and routed to the right owner
